text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm... Maya pretty much understands 
judo now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'd really like someone to properly 
teach me the moves, too. Isn't there a 
good partner around—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So with that, Sensei Grass and Sensei 
Curren, as experienced aikidoka! We're in 
your care for today's lesson!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course! Leave it to Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I'm far too inexperienced to be called a 
master, still being in training myself. 
But I'll do my best to be of help~!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: All right, here goes... Hup!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? A one-arm shoulder throw?! 
Busting out a big move right off the bat!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see... Looks like you've already got all 
the key points memorized~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Maya-chan. Could you show me 
your other techniques just in case?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, okay! Make sure you watch Maya lots 
and lots, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Phew... How was that!? Maya's tricks were 
all super cool, weren't they!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to be able to move like this while 
being self-taught is truly wonderful. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Curren-chan. Do you have just a moment?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Maya-chan. Regarding practice— 
shall we start from the basics once more?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To start off, let's see... About 100 
breakfalls, please♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehk!? 100 times!? We're doing it that 
many times--!!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Maya-chan! Curren will cheer 
you on with all her might, okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fifty-twwooo... fifty-threeee... Ugh. Are 
we still going? Isn't that enough 
already~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're giving up? Aww... You're so 
sparkling and super cute when you work 
hard, Maya-chan. What a shame... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Really? Is hard-working Maya cute? 
Am I super sparkly?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! So... okay? I want Maya-chan to show 
Curren even more of her cute side♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan's issue lies in her incomplete 
judo fundamentals. However, nothing is 
quite as tedious as basic drills, is it? 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will strictly hammer the fundamentals 
into her, so please support her gently, 
Curren-chan.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I call it 'Operation Carrot and Stick'♪ 
Together, shall we help Maya-chan grow 
stronger?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Being able to say you'll be a strict 
mentor is what makes you so cool, 
Grass-san...♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, you're starting to lose your 
focus. Next up is 200 sword strikes, you 
know~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! This is so rough! Help me, 
Professor Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, okaaay! Maya-chan, fight on, fight 
on~♪
